title: The 4 Best Countertop Ice Makers for RV and Camping
h1: The 4 Best Countertop Ice Makers for RV and Camping
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for countertop ice makers for rv and camping, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at countertop ice makers for rv and camping using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Frigidaire Countertop Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 26 lbs of bullet-shaped ice per day, 9 pieces ready in about 7 minutes, Compact, light enough for one person to carry.
strengths: Light and compact enough to stow in an RV cabinet or truck bed between trips
Simple controls mean nothing to configure once you're set up at a campsite
26 lbs a day is enough for a cooler and drinks for a small group
limitations: Bullet ice melts faster than nugget ice, so a cooler needs more frequent topping off
No handle on most versions, slightly awkward to carry loaded with water
Draws power the whole time it's cycling, worth checking against your generator or inverter capacity
features: 26 lbs of bullet-shaped ice per day
Compact, light enough for one person to carry
No water line or drain needed

products.name: Igloo Automatic Self-Cleaning Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 26 lbs of ice per 24 hours, Automatic 5-cycle self-cleaning function, Large or small cube selector.
strengths: Self-cleaning cycle matters more on a machine that sits unused between trips and can develop odors
Compact size fits a cabinet shelf or a milk crate for transport
Choice of cube size is handy for coolers versus drinks
limitations: Reservoir needs refilling roughly daily with steady use at a campsite
Plastic housing is less rugged-feeling than metal RV gear
9 to 10 minutes per fresh batch feels slow when a cooler is empty

products.name: Euhomy Nugget Ice Maker Countertop
products.blurb: Key specs: Up to 34 lbs of nugget ice per day, First batch ready in about 6 minutes, Built-in carry handle.
strengths: Higher 34 lb/day output keeps up with a group filling a cooler for a multi-day trip
Carry handle is a genuine plus for loading it in and out of a vehicle
Nugget ice packs a cooler more densely than bullet ice, which helps with cold retention
limitations: Larger and heavier than the compact bullet-ice machines
Higher power draw during production, more to consider on limited generator or battery power
Costs more than the basic Frigidaire or Igloo
features: Up to 34 lbs of nugget ice per day
First batch ready in about 6 minutes

products.name: EUHOMY Countertop Bullet Ice Maker, 26 lb/Day
strengths: Carry handle for RVs and parties
limitations: Ice melts in the unrefrigerated basket

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
